title: HaltSQL runtime configuration
description: How HaltSQL runs: listen address, TLS, auth tokens, policies, audit, logging. String values may use ${env:NAME}, ${file:/path}, ${vault:path#field}, ${aws-sm:id[#key]} and ${gcp-sm:name[#key]} placeholders.

listen.description: Address as host:port. Default 127.0.0.1:8080. Env: HALTSQL_LISTEN.

tls.description: TLS for the HTTP server. cert and key are required together.

cert.description: Path to the PEM certificate chain (or inline PEM).

key.description: Path to (or ${file:...} contents of) the PEM private key.

client_ca.description: PEM CA bundle used to verify client certificates (mTLS).

client_auth.description: Whether to request client certificates. optional/required need client_ca.

items.description: token:<name>, oidc:<provider> or mtls:<spiffe-id or CN>.

max_tracked_queries.description: Distinct query fingerprints tracked for the report.

auth.description: Caller authentication: static bearer tokens, OIDC JWTs, mTLS.

tokens.description: Accepted tokens; each is pinned to one policy.

token_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the token (64 characters).

policy.description: Name of the policy this token may use.

context.description: Context bound to this token (e.g. tenant_id). When set, the request body cannot supply or override these fields.

additionalProperties.description: A value or a list of values.

request_context_fields.description: Context fields the request body may still supply. Default []. Setting this or context binds the token: no other body field is accepted.

allow_unauthenticated.description: Accept requests without a token (uses default_policy). Local development only. Env: HALTSQL_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED.

items.description: An OpenID Connect provider whose JWTs are accepted as bearer tokens.

name.description: Unique provider name (shown in audit logs).

issuer.description: Issuer URL (https; http only with allow_insecure_http).

jwks_uri.description: JWKS URL. Default: discovered from issuer/.well-known/openid-configuration.

algorithms.description: Accepted signature algorithms. Default [RS256, ES256]. none and HS* are rejected.

jwks_cache_seconds.description: How long fetched keys are cached.

policy.description: Pinned policy name (use this or policy_claim).

policy_claim.description: Claim whose value names the policy (needs allowed_policies).

policy_from_groups.description: Select the policy from the token's groups: the first map entry whose group the token has wins, else default. Use instead of policy / policy_claim.

claim.description: Claim holding the groups (a string or an array of strings; exact name, then dot path).

default.description: Policy when no group matches. Default: reject the token.

context_claims.description: Context field -> claim path (exact claim name first, then a dot path like org.id).

required_claims.description: Claims that must match: a string (equal, or contained in an array / space-separated value) or a list (all contained).

request_context_fields.description: Context fields the request body may still supply. Default [].

allow_insecure_http.description: Allow http issuer/jwks URLs. Tests only.

mtls.description: Client-certificate identities. Requires server.tls.client_ca and client_auth optional/required.

spiffe_id.description: Exact SPIFFE ID URI SAN, e.g. spiffe://corp.example/ns/a/sa/b.

policy.description: Policy this identity is pinned to.

context.description: Static context values for this identity.

request_context_fields.description: Context fields the request body may still supply.

policies.description: Policies to load: files, inline, signed bundles or remote bundle sources.

items.description: A policy file or an inline policy.

path.description: Path to a policy file (YAML or JSON), relative to this config.

inline.description: An inline Policy document (apiVersion and kind optional).

name.description: Policy name, referenced by Config tokens. Letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'.

dialect.description: SQL dialect: "postgres" or a version such as "postgres-17".

search_path.description: Schemas used to resolve unqualified table names, in order. The first entry also qualifies unqualified table keys. Default [public].

catalog.description: Optional catalog snapshot: a path (relative to the policy file) or an inline snapshot.

oneOf.description: Path to a snapshot file (YAML or JSON).

metadata.description: Free-form information about the snapshot (source, time, tool version). `authoritative: false` marks a data catalog's view written by `haltsql schema fetch`; it is refused as a policy catalog.

tables.description: Tables keyed by "schema.table", written exactly as Postgres stores them (no case folding).

columns.description: Complete column list of the table, in table order.

items.description: A column name, or a name with its type.

type.description: Postgres type name, e.g. int8, text, uuid.

max_joins.description: Maximum number of joins per statement.

require_limit.description: Require every SELECT to have a constant LIMIT no larger than max.

mode.description: bound: tenant predicates compare to a $n parameter that HaltSQL binds (recommended). literal: they compare to a literal equal to the context value.

keys.description: Tenancy keys mapped to context placeholders, e.g. {tenant: "${ctx.tenant_id}"}.

additionalProperties.description: Context placeholder: "${ctx.<field>}", filled from the request context at verify time.

tables.description: Allowed tables keyed by "table" or "schema.table". Quote names that need case: '"MixedCase"."Orders"'.

columns.description: Readable columns: "*" or a list of names.

oneOf.description: All columns of the table (needs a catalog snapshot to expand SELECT *).
Explicit column names. Unquoted names are lower-cased; use double quotes to keep case.

tenant_column.description: Column that holds the tenant id. Shorthand for tenant_columns when tenancy defines exactly one key.

tenant_columns.description: Tenant-scoping columns mapped to tenancy key names, e.g. {org_id: org, workspace_id: workspace}.

writes.description: Writes allowed on this table (also require the statement kind in statements.allow).

insert.description: Allow INSERT (tenant columns must be set to the tenant value).

update.description: Allow UPDATE: "*", a list of updatable columns, or false.

operators.description: Allowed operators. Default: comparison, arithmetic, ||, LIKE/regex, JSON and array operators.

extend.description: Adds operators to the defaults (or to allow).

casts.description: Allowed cast target types (deny by default). Default: built-in scalar types (text, integers, numeric, floats, bool, date/time, uuid, json, jsonb, bytea).

items.description: PostgreSQL type name, e.g. int4 or app.status.

extend.description: Adds types to the defaults (or to allow).

items.description: PostgreSQL type name, e.g. inet or app.status.

deny_casts.description: Cast target types denied even when casts lists them. Default: the reg* family and txid_snapshot.

allow_explain.description: Allow plain EXPLAIN (never ANALYZE) of an allowed statement.

mode.description: enforce: deny violations. shadow: report violations but allow (for rollouts).

oneOf.description: Signed policy bundle (verified by the server before use).

bundle.description: Path to a .haltsqlbundle file, relative to this config.

public_keys.description: Trusted ed25519 public keys: file paths, inline PEM, or base64 of the 32 raw bytes.

name_prefix.description: Prefix added to the names of the policies in this bundle.

oneOf.description: Signed policy bundle fetched from a registry, S3 or HTTPS and polled for updates (verified by the server before use).

bundle_source.description: Where the bundle comes from: exactly one of oci, s3 or https.

plain_http.description: Talk plain http to the registry (loopback only).

credentials.description: Where AWS credentials come from (as for s3 audit sinks).

https.description: HTTPS URL of the .haltsqlbundle (http only for loopback).

name_prefix.description: Prefix added to the names of the policies in this bundle.

cache_dir.description: Directory for the last verified bundle (relative to this config).

auth.description: Registry or HTTPS credentials: token, or username and password.

default_policy.description: Policy used by unauthenticated requests. Env: HALTSQL_DEFAULT_POLICY.

watch.description: Reload policy files when they change.

sinks.description: Where audit records go. Default [{type: stdout}].

on_error.description: What to do when the sink cannot be written: fail_closed refuses requests (HTTP 503); buffer keeps records in memory and retries.

path.description: File path, relative to this config.

on_error.description: What to do when the sink cannot be written: fail_closed refuses requests (HTTP 503); buffer keeps records in memory and retries.

object_lock.description: S3 Object Lock retention for written objects.

batch.description: Batching of audit records into objects.

max_seconds.description: Seconds before a partial batch is flushed.

access_key_id.description: Access key id (static only; use a secret placeholder).

secret_access_key.description: Secret access key (static only; use a secret placeholder).

spool_dir.description: Local directory (relative to the config file) where records are spooled before upload and the hash-chain head is persisted, so the chain and object sequence continue across restarts. One directory per sink.

on_error.description: What to do when the sink cannot be written: fail_closed refuses requests (HTTP 503); buffer keeps records in memory and retries.

batch.description: Batching of audit records into objects.

max_seconds.description: Seconds before a partial batch is flushed.

file.description: Service account JSON key file (service_account_file only).

spool_dir.description: Local spool directory, as for s3 sinks (relative to the config file).

on_error.description: What to do when the sink cannot be written: fail_closed refuses requests (HTTP 503); buffer keeps records in memory and retries.

oneOf.description: Elasticsearch or OpenSearch (bulk API). Needs url or urls, and index or data_stream.

url.description: Cluster URL (https; http only for loopback). Use url or urls.

urls.description: Several cluster node URLs (use url or urls).

items.description: Node URL (https; http only for loopback).

index.description: Target index (lower case). Use index or data_stream.

data_stream.description: Target data stream (lower case). Use index or data_stream.

auth.description: Credentials: api_key, or username and password (use secret placeholders).

api_key.description: Encoded API key (sent as Authorization: ApiKey ...).

pipeline.description: Ingest pipeline to run on each record.

ca_file.description: PEM CA bundle (path relative to this config, or inline PEM).

batch.description: Batching of audit records into one request.

flush_interval_ms.description: Milliseconds before a partial batch is sent.

on_error.description: What to do when the sink cannot be written: fail_closed refuses requests (HTTP 503); buffer keeps up to max_buffer_records in memory and retries; drop discards records (counted in metrics; not fail closed).

max_buffer_records.description: Records kept in memory while the sink is down (on_error buffer only; at least batch.max_records). Default 10000.

oneOf.description: Apache Kafka topic (one message per audit record).

enabled.description: Use TLS (default true when tls is given).

ca_file.description: PEM CA bundle for the broker certificates.

sasl.description: SASL authentication. PLAIN needs tls unless every broker is loopback.

batch.description: Batching of audit records into one request.

flush_interval_ms.description: Milliseconds before a partial batch is sent.

on_error.description: What to do when the sink cannot be written: fail_closed refuses requests (HTTP 503); buffer keeps up to max_buffer_records in memory and retries; drop discards records (counted in metrics; not fail closed).

max_buffer_records.description: Records kept in memory while the sink is down (on_error buffer only; at least batch.max_records). Default 10000.

log_raw_sql.description: Include the raw SQL text in audit records.

otlp_endpoint.description: Legacy shorthand for telemetry.otlp.endpoint (use one or the other).

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers (values may use secret placeholders; redacted in config show).

secrets.description: Secret providers for ${vault:...}, ${aws-sm:...} and ${gcp-sm:...} placeholders. Values here may only use ${env:...} and ${file:...}.

address.description: Vault URL (https; http only for loopback).

auth.description: How HaltSQL logs in to Vault.

mount.description: Auth mount path. Default kubernetes or approle.

ca_file.description: CA bundle for the Vault server certificate.

project.description: Default project for short secret names.

opa.description: Open Policy Agent check after HaltSQL allows a query. OPA can only further deny; it never allows a query HaltSQL denied.

url.description: OPA base URL (https; http only for loopback).

on_error.description: When OPA cannot be reached or answers badly: deny (default) or keep HaltSQL's verdict.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers (values may use secret placeholders; redacted).

ca_file.description: PEM CA bundle (path relative to this config, or inline PEM).

ctx_placeholder.description: Context placeholder: "${ctx.<field>}", filled from the request context at verify time.
